_note: State overrides. Every constant not listed here is taken from data/constants.json unchanged: hot water demand, efficiencies, COP, installed costs (DCCEEW RIS Table 20 is national), rebate (0) and deal parameters. The efficiencies are the NSW climate zone (Zone 3) values; they have not been adjusted for this state's climate.
name: Queensland

EF_electricity_kgCO2e_per_kWh.source: DCCEEW, 'Australian National Greenhouse Accounts Factors 2026', Table 1, 'Queensland': scope 2 = 0.65, scope 3 = 0.11.
EF_electricity_kgCO2e_per_kWh.check: Read from the official XLSX (archived copy, captured 2026-09-10, text dump in data/source_text/national-greenhouse-accounts-factors-2026.xlsx.txt).

EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.source: DCCEEW, 'Australian National Greenhouse Accounts Factors 2026'. Table 5, 'Natural gas distributed in a pipeline', scope 1 combined gases = 51.53 kg CO2-e/GJ. Table 6, 'Queensland', Metro, scope 3 = 8.8 kg CO2-e/GJ.
EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.check: Read from the official XLSX (archived copy, captured 2026-09-10, text dump in data/source_text/national-greenhouse-accounts-factors-2026.xlsx.txt).
EF_gas_kgCO2e_per_MJ.note: UNIT TRAP: per MJ, not per GJ.

tariffs.electricityPlan: AGL Residential Standing Offer (time of use with controlled load)
tariffs.timeOfUse: Three rates: peak $0.434416/kWh 16:00 to 20:59, off-peak $0.063498/kWh 11:00 to 15:59, shoulder $0.22996/kWh 21:00 to 10:59. At 03:00 the shoulder rate applies. The cheaper midday rate is not used. The same 03:00 rate prices both an existing electric tank and the heat pump, so this choice lowers the gas switch saving and raises the electric tank saving compared with midday pricing.
tariffs.source: AER Consumer Data Right, Energy Product Reference Data API, postcode 4000. Raw responses in data/cdr_raw/qld/ (scripts/fetch_cdr_states.py).
tariffs.heatPumpRate: The heat pump is priced at the rate in force at 03:00 on a weekday, the overnight window a timer targets, as in NSW and Victoria (src/lib/cdr.ts).
tariffs.gst: CDR unit prices are stored the same way for every state, so all states are on the same basis.
